paragraphs.text: The Stasis Coffin was an artifact on Dominaria designed by Tawnos to put a person into stasis indefinitely.

The Stasis Coffin is a large metal box, seven feet in length, three feet in both width and height. It was originally designed by Tawnos to trap Mishra indefinitely, rather than kill him, it was instead used to preserve Tawnos and possibly his lover Ashnod through the Sylex Blast in 63 AR . It was later incorporated as part of the Temporal Anchor .
